notes: The pet page is less crowded when it folds: the labels under the icons and the health score row tuck away, leaving more room around your pet.

history.notes: The pet page now folds smoothly as you scroll and keeps your pet's speech bubble in view, with your pet and today's check-in on one screen.
The pet page now stops scrolling once it has folded, with your pet and today's check-in on one screen. The update popup has a little less space under its title.
The pet page folds as you scroll: the greeting, streak line and speech bubble tuck away and the pet shrinks, so your pet and today's check-in fit on one screen.
Dog reacts to your check-ins: a happy hop when a goal is met, and a sad look for a few seconds after a slip. The greeting is shorter, and Sign out is now at the bottom of Me.
Pet page: the back button to your pets list is always there, even with one pet.
Pet page: a back button to your pets list is always there, even with one pet. Plus the urge strength slider with feedback and evenly sized pet cards in list view.

Streaks: a flame shows how many days in a row on each pet. The sky is back with time of day and seasons. A clearer health bar, more breathing room, and the check-in card keeps its shape after you log.
Menus open reliably, the 28-day trail and milestones fit small phones, clearer settings rows, and bigger tap targets.
Your pet cards line up neatly in grid and list view, the add button now sits in the header, and the app stays in portrait.
Cleaner look: small headings now use the same clear font across the app, and your pet cards line up neatly in both grid and list view.
